decisions.reason: Narrative completeness does not change the separate lesson-value criterion; message 84 already independently updates that criterion.
Requiring a complete beginning-to-end moment does not alter permitted source material or the one-video batch constraint.
The completeness standard does not replace or modify the existing 20-to-120-second duration limits.
Capturing a complete moment does not change the independently defined hook-selection criterion.
Narrative completeness does not change visual editing style; message 84 already separately records its clean, simple, professional editing rules.
The completeness standard is a quality condition and does not change the already-current assignment of eight trial clips.
The narrative completeness change does not alter the existing caption color treatment.
The completeness standard neither introduces nor changes a caption-font requirement.
The revised narrative standard does not change the existing target of 180 approved clips per month.
